Reduce in case of rooftop landing spots
Defines the distance from accident site to the helicopter, in meters, above which the ambulance will be considered far. Default: 100 meters

Defines if the hospital crew walks to hospital with the patient (after unloading) or disappears few seconds after unloading completed. It applies to every ambulance crew (patient transfer or load unload from to ambulance and also for crew boarding and deboarding
0 Crew disappears (no hospital query executed, no risk of query or mission lock)

Defines the speed multiplier (based on road limits) for police and ambulance on scene. Default: 1.5

then.#comment: objective1 rebuilds accident_location, rescue_location and userA of an accepted second dispatch from the PRE_* LVARs, and nothing else clears them: a dispatch that does not write one of them (a SAR dispatch wrote no PRE_ACCIDENT_LOCATION, a dispatch outside a residential or userA scene wrote no PRE_RESCUE_LOCATION or PRE_USERA) was rebuilt on the location of an earlier dispatch (tester report 2026-10-11: the SAR dispatch started where the previous mission was). Every finished preview therefore starts from empty PRE_* and writes only what this dispatch generated.

organ kind setup.#comment: User request of 2026-10-21: the medical team transport (ID 101) and the urgent blood supply (ID 102) are organ transfers with another payload: voice_sfx is the suffix of the pack keys that have a variant for them (.T team, .B blood; empty for an organ), organ_item_text the words of the tablet message, organ_bar_label the text of the time bar, organ_margin_min and organ_margin_max the random margin in seconds added to the flight time for the latest arrival (organ 300 to 1200; team 240 to 720; blood 150 to 480). Called by timefororgantransport and by organ transfer.

landing spot follow injured.#comment: One-shot update of the DEFAULT landing spot after the injured_human has been relocated (ambulance shelter, registry recovery, scene threads): called right after the relocation command, when the injured has stopped (drive_object is synchronous, move_object is instant). Nothing runs in the background. It does nothing unless the default spot was created at the injured (landing_spot_follow, set by shared repeated block 027) and the user did not choose another one (customLZ). The user choosing the spot (landing spot selection) never triggers an update.

road nodes generator.#comment: Approach points from the traffic routes, not from OSM data: for up to 3 arms a car route route1..3 from a random point 420-520 m away to rescue_location (accident_location when rescue_location is missing or farther than 300 m) is created, once, and the traffic uses it (random traffic does not create its own). Its [lat, lon, alt, spd] entries are walked backward from the end: wpc = 25 m, wprescue = 60 m, wph = 110 m (heading helper); wpt is the first entry where the traffic of the arm starts. A route longer than 1200 m (the point snapped to a distant road) or an arm whose wprescue lies within 25 m of an earlier one is retried once on another bearing. No route is created in legacy routing mode (SKIP QUERY or ambu_route_mode legacy): the caller falls back to its cardinal points and random traffic creates its own routes.
